transcript:
Agent: Safe Footpaths, this is Priya, how can I help?
Caller: Hi Priya, it's Sarah Nguyen. I manage Harbourview Body Corporate. We've got a few trip hazards around our building at 27 Ferry Lane, Newstead, Queensland 4006.
Agent: Thanks Sarah. Can you describe what you're seeing?
Caller: Sure. Near the main entrance there are two slabs that have lifted, maybe fifteen millimetres each. Then at the bin store door there's one that's closer to twenty-five millimetres, that's the one a resident nearly went over last week. And along the side walkway there are two hairline cracks that are just starting to catch.
Agent: Is this urgent or can we schedule it in?
Caller: No rush, sometime in the next few weeks is fine.
Agent: Perfect. What's the best way to send the quote?
Caller: Email is best, it's sarah.nguyen@harbourview-bc.example. Or you can call me on 0412 345 678.
Agent: Great, we'll get that to you shortly.
